vulnerability.explanation: fprintf is called with "%s" and fip->field_name, but anonymous fields created by _TIFFCreateAnonField() have field_name == NULL. Passing a NULL pointer to "%s" is undefined behavior and can crash. This occurs when printing a directory that contains such anonymous fields.
